facts: The body defines project work item categories and links a conceptual work-item-types article, then contains only The work item type object, Attributes and one 200 response example.
Attributes describe id, name, description, logo_props, epic/default/active flags, level, workspace/project ownership, audit/deletion and external correlation fields.
There is no method/path table, request body, action instruction or operation link in the page body. The generic front-matter description mentioning endpoints does not supply an HTTP contract.
